title: Design System: The Cricket Fan — Composer

display.purpose: One section header per view — 'DRAFTS & GENERATORS', 'EDITOR & PREVIEW'. Never body copy.

title.purpose: Card and panel titles, draft headings.

body.purpose: Editable draft text, paragraph copy, editor textarea.

label.purpose: Meta rows, chip text, form labels, timestamps — always uppercase, always Signal Muted at rest.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions (hover, focus, panel reveal). No bounce, no elastic.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action per view — Generate, Download PNG's confirming action, etc.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e8432e; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c22f1c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8432e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every non-primary action — Copy Text, Browse Bank, aspect-ratio toggles.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #0a0a0a; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1a1a1a; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8432e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Source Chip
components.description: Tags a draft's origin: bank / bot / llm / freeform.
components.css: .ds-chip-source { display: inline-block; background: #3a1712; color: #e8432e; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Tags content-bank category: wiki_record / anecdote / story.
components.css: .ds-chip-category { display: inline-block; background: #0a0a0a; color: #5dc4d9; border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Replaces the raw unstyled input/select across composer — category field, AI prompt, bot-kind select.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0a0a0a; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #888888; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #e8432e; }

components.name: Draft Card
components.description: A single draft row in the feed — flat, bordered, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #0a0a0a; border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #e8432e; } .ds-card-meta { display: block; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #888888; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-text { margin: 0; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #888888; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #ffffff; border-bottom-color: #e8432e; }

narrative.overview: Composer is a sportswriter's desk at the ground, late in the day, under stadium floodlights — not a SaaS admin panel. The energy is wire-service urgency: facts come in, copy goes out, fast, with a single decisive red the same way a press-room clock or an on-air tally light reads as "this matters, act now." Everything else stays quiet — near-black surfaces, tight neutral type — so that one red never has to compete for attention. This system explicitly rejects the generic-admin-dashboard defaults composer shipped with at first build: plain HTML select and input elements, no visual hierarchy between the four content sources, no color distinguishing a wiki-record fact from a hand-written anecdote, flat gray-on-gray panels. It also deliberately does not reuse the main app's team-blue/team-gold pairing — composer is a working tool, not a matchday scoreboard, and needed its own accent identity rather than borrowing the fixture colors.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black, flat, tonally layered — no shadows, depth comes from surface-vs-bg-vs-border contrast alone.
One confident accent (Wire Red) carries all primary actions and states; it never shares a screen with equal-weight competing color.
A second, cooler color (Floodlight Cyan) exists only to code categories/sources — it is never used for actions.
Oswald carries display/section weight; Space Grotesk carries everything you read and type.
Fast and efficient, polished, a little playful — never sterile, never corporate.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Wire Red appears on exactly one interactive element's resting state per view — the single primary action. Everything else that needs emphasis uses weight, size, or a neutral surface change, never a second saturated fill.

rules.name: The Cool-Codes, Warm-Acts Rule
rules.body: Floodlight Cyan never sits on a button or triggers an action; Wire Red never labels a category. If a color is clickable-and-consequential, it's red. If it's informational, it's cyan or neutral.

rules.name: The Loud-Then-Quiet Rule
rules.body: A view gets exactly one Display-weight moment at its top; everything below drops straight to Title/Body/Label. No intermediate 'Headline' tier.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If an element needs to look 'elevated,' change its surface tone or add the 1px border — never add a shadow. The one exception is a sparing glow behind the Wire Red primary action on hover.

dos: Do use Wire Red (#e8432e) for exactly one primary action per view, and Oswald Display type for exactly one section header per view.
Do code content sources and categories with Floodlight Cyan or neutral chips, never with a second saturated red.
Do keep every card, panel, and input flat: Ash Surface + 1px Border Line, no box-shadow.
Do surface real error/empty-state text instead of a generic failure message.
donts: Don't reintroduce team-blue (#004ba0) or team-gold (#ffcb05) as composer's accent.
Don't use raw unstyled HTML select/input elements.
Don't add box-shadows, glassmorphism, or soft glows to cards or panels.
Don't use gradient text, side-stripe borders, or numbered section eyebrows (01/02/03) as default scaffolding.
Don't let Floodlight Cyan appear on a button or trigger an action.
